rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing a society or system based on social equality and equal rights.

example.english: This society is egalitarian, with everyone having equal rights.
example.traditional: 呢個社會以平等為本，人人都有同等權利。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 se5 wui2 ji5 ping4 dang2 wai6 bun2 jan4 jan4 dou1 jau5 tung4 dang2 kyun4 lei6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who promotes equal rights for everyone.

example.english: I am an egalitarian who believes everyone should have the same opportunities, regardless of their background.

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the person follows egalitarianism as a social or political belief.

example.english: This scholar is regarded as a committed egalitarian who advocates social equality.
